resources.string: The history and versions of android are interesting to know. The code names of android ranges from A to J currently, such as Aestro, Blender, Cupcake, Donut, Eclair, Froyo, Gingerbread, Honeycomb, Ice Cream Sandwich, Jelly Bean, KitKat and Lollipop. Let\'s understand the android history in a sequence. Initially, Andy Rubin founded Android Incorporation in Palo Alto, California, United States in October, 2003.
